normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 10 bands to access WaterColor amenities and community pools- Located in the beautiful Park community of WaterColor- Close distance to Cerulean Park- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- 4 adult bikes provided- 6-Passenger low speed vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Escape for sweet days of beach living at 127 Buttercup Street, a 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home that sleeps 10 in beautiful WaterColor. Tucked along the Emerald Coast, this premier destination offers a beach club, lazy river, biking trails, and diverse activities for all ages in a stunning seaside setting. Guests will love swimming in the Boathouse Pool or renting kayaks to explore Western Lake—only a 4-minute walk away!Set on a quiet street framed with lush greenery, this darling 2-level cottage offers a peaceful escape. The front porch’s rocking chairs and wood dining table for 8 were made for unhurried mid-morning brunches and afternoons sipping lemony iced tea. Step inside the first floor and find classic décor sprinkled with coastal charm and artwork, creating an elegant and comfortable atmosphere throughout the great room. The spacious living area’s 2 soft couches and 2 striped accent chairs frame a Smart TV—perfect for streaming movies and music. Continue into the kitchen space, equipped with high-end appliances and a 4-seat breakfast bar, where guests can plan the day over morning coffee. To the side is a dining table with 2 long benches for sit-down meals. A grill and an outdoor shower out the back door complete the beachy setting. At the end of the night, retire to the 1 primary bedroom with a king bed or the 2 guest bedrooms with queen beds on this floor.Up the wooden staircase, a charming and spacious guest bedroom boasts 2 full beds, 2 twin beds, a private bathroom, and plenty of room to play, perfect for children or guests who don’t mind sharing space.Enjoy all the charm and amenities of WaterColor at 127 Buttercup Street. Parking for 2 vehicles, plus 4 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, makes it easy to explore the area and the rest of Scenic 30A. Designated beach access is at WaterColor Beach Club—only a 6-minute walk or short trolley ride away. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: 2 Full Beds, and 2 Twin Beds, and Full Sleeper Sofa Private Bathroom with Shower Only

It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Escape for sweet days of beach living at 127 Buttercup Street, a 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home that sleeps 10 in beautiful WaterColor. Tucked along the Emerald Coast, this premier destination offers a beach club, lazy river, biking trails, and diverse activities for all ages in a stunning seaside setting. Guests will love swimming in the Boathouse Pool or renting kayaks to explore Western Lake—only a 4-minute walk away! Set on a quiet street framed with lush greenery, this darling 2-level cottage offers a peaceful escape. The front porch’s rocking chairs and wood dining table for 8 were made for unhurried mid-morning brunches and afternoons sipping lemony iced tea. Step inside the first floor and find classic décor sprinkled with coastal charm and artwork, creating an elegant and comfortable atmosphere throughout the great room. The spacious living area’s 2 soft couches and 2 striped accent chairs frame a Smart TV—perfect for streaming movies and music. Continue into the kitchen space, equipped with high-end appliances and a 4-seat breakfast bar, where guests can plan the day over morning coffee. To the side is a dining table with 2 long benches for sit-down meals. A grill and an outdoor shower out the back door complete the beachy setting. At the end of the night, retire to the 1 primary bedroom with a king bed or the 2 guest bedrooms with queen beds on this floor. Up the wooden staircase, a charming and spacious guest bedroom boasts 2 full beds, 2 twin beds, a private bathroom, and plenty of room to play, perfect for children or guests who don’t mind sharing space. Enjoy all the charm and amenities of WaterColor at 127 Buttercup Street. Parking for 2 vehicles, plus 4 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, makes it easy to explore the area and the rest of Scenic 30A. Designated beach access is at WaterColor Beach Club—only a 6-minute walk or short trolley ride away. Book today!
